# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

**Top pick: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, about $120 with a code**
- SoundGuys rated its noise cancelling better than 63% of earbuds it measured. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 water resistance, and it gets about 5.7 hours per charge with ANC on ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- It lists at $149.99. Dealectric says code AFSC20 took $29.99 off in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, bringing it to $120: [buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). Dealectric earns a commission on that link, and the store's checkout has the final word on the price.

**Other good options**
- **Nothing Ear (3), just under $150 on Amazon.** It has the strongest ANC of the picks in iTech Level's guide, with LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging. The downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics and about 5 hours per charge ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/), [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- **Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134 on Amazon from Samsung's store.** Its ANC is great, it has IPX7 water resistance, and it works on most Android phones but is best on Samsung ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **Sony WF-C710N, about $119 at Walmart.** What Hi-Fi? named it best budget for its bass and controlled sound ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)). Sound Mavericks lists 8.5 hours of battery with ANC on, but no LDAC ([Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)).
- **AirPods Pro 2 (renewed), around $150 on sale.** If you have an iPhone, SlashGear calls their ANC exceptional. Apple no longer sells them new, so prices vary by seller ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **Soundcore P31i, $59.99.** It's a cheap pick with adaptive ANC, multipoint and a 4.4-star Amazon average over 8,000+ reviews. Its ANC is weaker than the others here ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

**How to choose**
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 if you can find a good price. The new AirPods 5 ($129, or $149 with wireless charging) have an open fit, so they block less noise ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- **Android:** Liberty 4 Pro or Nothing Ear (3).
- **Samsung phone:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
- **Longest battery:** Sony WF-C710N.

Only the Liberty 4 Pro has a direct buy link in my search results. For the others, the guides linked above have current retailer links, and prices change often, so check before you buy.
